description: Today's input and output price per million tokens (usd_per_mtok) for a model id, with the first-party source. Accepts short or aliased ids (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-4o", "gemini-2.5-pro"). Pass provider to disambiguate a bare id shared across vendors.

model.description: Model id or alias, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-4o".

provider.description: Optional provider slug (e.g. "openai", "anthropic") to disambiguate a bare id.

name: current_price
title: Current price
